plan: My private value is $48, which means I would be willing to pay up to $48 to acquire this item. However, I want to maximize profit by paying as little as possible. Since the winner pays the third-highest bid, I want to bid strategically. With a high value of $48, I should bid close to but not exactly at my value. A bid around $47-$48 gives me the best chance of winning while minimizing my payment.

My value is $38. In a second-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is typically to bid your true value. This means bidding $38 ensures I maximize my potential profit. If I win, I'll pay less than my bid. If I bid less, I risk losing the item even when winning would be profitable. With no prior round history and values drawn independently, a true-value bid is most rational.
